name: Tradable NA Rent Financing Platform SSTN
oneLiner: PC0000031 is a KYC-gated Tradable senior secured term note on a North American rent-financing platform; contract-priced at $1 par, not a liquid stablecoin.
collateral: Senior secured term notes tied to a North American rent-financing platform and tokenized through Tradable private-credit issuance rails.
pegMechanism: Contract-priced at $1.00 note par rather than a liquid secondary-market peg; investors rely on issuer servicing and note repayment.

notices.title: Contract-priced private credit
notices.message: CoinGecko reports a live $1 price and market cap but zero 24h volume; Pharos treats this as a par-valued private-credit note rather than a liquid stablecoin.

notices.title: Launch date not publicly established
notices.message: Tradable's reviewed product documentation and zkSync contract-address page identify the token and current contract architecture but do not publish a reliable PC0000031 launch or implementation date.

listingStatusReview.reason: Out of scope: this is a permissioned, deal-specific private-credit ownership note priced at contractual par, not a transferable stable-value monetary instrument.
